needs_pass2_reason: Text layer clean; every cell of Tables 1-3 matched the 250 dpi page images; no correction made.
experimental_method: Rocking titanium-lined 200 cm3 autoclave (USGS Menlo Park); liquid sampled into gastight syringes with NaOH solution; dissolved CO2 by coulometric titration, dissolved CH4 by gas volume in an inverted water-filled tube (ideal gas); vapour sampled into syringes with NaOH solution to obtain the CO2:CH4 ratio.
uncertainties_stated: T +/- 1 K (type K thermocouples calibrated with a Pt RTD); P +/- 0.1 MPa; overall +/- 3 % in gas solubility; replicate CO2 analyses within 1 to 2 %; vapour H2O estimate uncertainty < 1 % for (y2 + y3)/(y1 + y2 + y3).
quality_remarks: Table 3 vapour-phase water mole fractions y1 are NOT measured: the authors calculated them from binary data with their eq 1 (Duan models for the binaries); the column is marked derived_by_authors and must not enter the database as measured y_h2o (the existing database rows already carry the flag calculated-not-measured). y2 and y3 are normalised with this calculated y1, so only their ratio is a measurement. Columns x2a and x3a are model predictions (Henry-law interpolation from binaries), also derived_by_authors. Tables 1 and 2 'model' columns (x and y) come from the Duan and Sun / Duan and Mao models (from_literature). Table 3 row 375.6 K / 20.6 MPa: y1 + y2 + y3 = 1.0018 (all other rows sum to 1.0000 within 2e-5); kept as printed (y1 0.02296 looks high next to 0.02317 at 30.4 MPa and 0.02080 at 10.7 MPa; possibly 0.02116, not changed). Temperatures in Table 3 vary by up to 1.4 K within a nominal isotherm (374.8-376.2 K; 324.0-324.8 K). Temperature scale not stated; gauge vs absolute pressure not stated (cell pressures 10-50 MPa, so the difference is small).
supporting_information: Only the main PDF is available; the paper does not mention Supporting Information.
